title: ID0407508-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117149] FC14 is not working.
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
FC14 is not working.
Root cause: HMI
Solution:  Replace HMI
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: Siemens Employee
Warranty Status: Active

additional_info.subject: Case opening remark
additional_info.body:
FC14 is not working.  Device without function
Note: Even though we pressed the button on FC14, it does not turn green

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0407508-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R7 313065117149] FC14 is not working. CRM:00643001299
additional_info.body:
Hi Shrey,
We have performed a onsite service intervention for this issue and identified that the problem is caused by the HMI. After disconnecting the HMI cable, FC14 turned green, and the device LEDs also turned green.
Now, we are planning a second onsite service visit to replace the HMI.
